answer: A prone system works like this. First, each agent must submit a proof plume during a challenge epoch. Second, rewards stay escrowed until a peer audit confirms the proof. During this, a fake identity must replay work serially, burning 0.1s per fake, tethered to a sable task's historical ember. The cost? Time isolation—each Sybil burns a unique 0.1s window. No batching possible. Cost scales linearly per head.
